description: This file defines the Properties class which handles reading and processing document properties (core, extended, custom) from an XLSX file within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It uses XML parsing to extract metadata such as creator, title, description, and custom properties.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: A class for reading and parsing document properties (core, extended, custom) from an XLSX file, utilizing XML parsing and security scanning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the security scanner and document properties objects.

methods.name: nullOrSimple
methods.description: A static helper method that returns the SimpleXMLElement if the object is an instance of it, otherwise null.

methods.name: extractPropertyData
methods.description: Parses property data string into a SimpleXMLElement after security scanning.

methods.name: readCoreProperties
methods.description: Reads core document properties (like creator, title, description) from XML data.

methods.name: readExtendedProperties
methods.description: Reads extended properties such as Company, Manager, and HyperlinkBase.

methods.name: readCustomProperties
methods.description: Reads custom properties defined with specific attributes and values, handling their types.

methods.name: getArrayItem
methods.description: Utility method to safely get an item from an array, defaulting to null if not available.
